answer: Social Matters >> Clothing & Lifestyle Question ID: 39888 Country: United Kingdom Title: My beard is not growing on both sides of my face and it is only growing on my chin and throat area Question: My beard is not growing on both sides of my face and it is only growing on my chin and throat area. Due to this it does not look good and I am ashamed of my beard. I would like to grow a full and proper beard. I know it is haram to shave or trim the beard but I see no other option in order to grow a proper beard. Is there anything I could do for hair to grow on both sides of my face? Answer ID: 39888 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1449/1136/B=1433) It is natural system; it is out of man’s reach. However, the physicians say that if Roghan Baiza Murgh is applied at a place where hair of beard does not grow, it is hoped that it will be helpful. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
